note: The Differentiation record, machine-readable (kogaki#1206, owner decision
2026-09-26). It replaces two things at once: the free-text hint each
reader-path unit's prompt used to carry ('choose a reader experience
unlikely to be the one they choose'), and the collision refusal that used
to be read only AFTER all three units had already composed a full
Candidate. This record is decided BEFORE any unit composes: one entry per
unit, assigning the reader-state dimension its path leads with, the
opening Move its first Leg binds, and (where the Brief carries Journey
material) where that material is placed. The three Candidates differ BY
ASSIGNMENT, not by chance.
IT ALSO LISTS THE MOVES THE FIRST LEG MAY BIND (kogaki#1216; kogaki#1699).
`leg1_survivors` is every Move whose `takes` the Persona's prior-knowledge
line meets, unranked; each unit's `opening_move` is drawn from it. It is
decided HERE because it is a property of the Brief and of no path. The
record carries no Reader start: it is retired (kogaki#1699).
THIS RECORD IS THE BLOCK'S CURRENT OUTPUT, AND NOT ITS DEFINITION
(SPEC-draft-pipeline §"Journey register is an axis of Candidate
differentiation"). A later mechanism deciding differentiation a
different way keeps the same state name and the same boundary — before
the reader-path units start — and may reshape this record's fields
without that section itself moving.
SPEC REFERENCES IN THIS FILE (kogaki#902; one carrier, kogaki#982).
The rule these entries are written under lives in ONE place:
`src/SPEC-REFERENCES.md`. It is not restated here.
THE NAMES THIS FILE USES, and the spec each one names:
Journey register is an axis of Candidate differentiation
SPEC-draft-pipeline

leg1_survivors.rule: EXCLUSION, NOT OPTIMIZATION (kogaki#1216 amendment; kogaki#1699). A Move is EXCLUDED when an entry of its `takes` is not met by what the Persona's prior-knowledge line (`reader.prior_knowledge` in the input) supplies -- the kinds matching as words and the `what` lines by sense, never verbatim; a Move whose `takes` is empty is never excluded. Every Move not excluded is a survivor, and survivors are NOT RANKED -- no score exists anywhere. List every survivor by id
leg1_survivors.count_is_rendered: the Brief records how many Moves survived, under its tradeoffs. A count of one names the LIBRARY, not the rule, as the cause of a repeated opening, and the fix is a Move extracted from an opening passage
leg1_survivors.rationale: the first Leg binds a survivor by the same composition order every Leg uses -- Strand information, then Leg reasoning, then the Move -- and the grounds test applies to it; the Move-fit judge re-asks TAKEN of Leg 1 against the Persona's prior-knowledge line. An empty list is refused: a library with no Move able to open from what the Persona knows is a store fault to name, never a Brief to compose

entries.count_rationale: one entry per reader-path unit — a record with fewer entries leaves a unit with no assignment, and one with more names a unit that does not exist

unit_number.rationale: the join key the reader-path unit's own prompt and the assembled Candidate's tag both resolve through — never the unit's opening Move or dimension, because those are exactly the values being assigned

dimension.rationale: the Move library's five reader-state dimensions; two units leading with the same dimension are not differentiated by assignment, they are differentiated by luck

opening_move.rationale: the id the unit's first Leg must bind — checked at composition by the unit's own retries and re-checked at assembly against the Candidate that resulted (src/assemble.mjs), naming the unit on a mismatch

journey_placement.absent_when: the Brief carries no Journey material at all (journeyBearingStrands over the Brief's Strand set returns no Strand)
journey_placement.rationale: where this unit's path places the Journey register, decided in advance rather than left to whichever unit's Model happens to reach for it (SPEC-draft-pipeline §"Journey register is an axis of Candidate differentiation")

reader_experience.rationale: one sentence of intended reader experience — carried into the unit's own prompt so the unit composes toward it, not a description read back after the fact

refusal.rationale: a record with two entries sharing a leading dimension, or an opening Move outside moves_you_may_bind, is refused at the state with the entry named — never silently repaired and never deferred to the units that would compose against it
